content: Nkye bi ifàsɛmà muswɛɛŋ bi ŋakwo? Itàkal naa nkye bi iwe anà mfun, asànaa bumwɛy, yà in'kaan muswɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ, itàkal myàfà akà bɛ?
Wɛɛ bɛ làbà un'kaan abi, bàsön uboo a mpem abi, awà bàyöb anà bàtäŋ baar banswà.
Inye, yà ndandaa naa bɛ làbà un'kaan a Klistɔ bàsön ntɔn isal abi, bàsön anki anà tiin, wɛɛ anà Dweelà a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈, kudu a mɛsà a nkɔŋ anki, wɛɛ udu a mɛsà a in'twaŋ, udu a mpem.
Lalà kam iwà bi alà kusà a Nzam u mbwo a Klistɔ.
Bi ikyey anki uyɔl naa bi ŋakwo kan'kwo mukyer undiir mwɛy u ngwal abi ŋakwo, wɛɛ ngwal abi yan'fà akà Nzam.
Nde sye mbuur kibuul bàŋàkwo mukal asyääl a Nkwà akün, kà ntɔn un'kaan anki, wɛɛ ntɔn Dweelà, ntɔn un'kaan akyer afàdwa, wɛɛ Dweelà afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyekà, isàkal naa isal a ukwà, bàsön a ngɔk udu a in'kul kyàpɛ làkoo, abun baar a Isàlɛl bàkwe anki musyebà mbɔɔn ntabwey a Mɔsɛ ntɔn làkoo làkäl u ntabwey ande, làkoo mpa làläm.
Ntɔn nkye isal a Dweelà mpa ikal kya anà làkoo aŋàsöönà?
Isàkal naa isal ifàpà ntaaŋàmbar kyàkäl anà làkoo, ntɔn nkye isal a balàbal mpa iwal kya làkoo aŋàsöönà?
Abun, undiir kàkäl anà làkoo kàwɛl anki làkoo, ntɔn làkoo aŋàbà làŋàsöönà.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa undiir mpa afàlam kàpɛ làkoo, aben undiir afàlam mpa upà wa làkoo aŋàsöönà?
Ntɔn bi ibye anà làkyän atub alà, waa bi iwe anà làkyän a mbɔɔn.
Bi ikyer anki asànaa Mɔsɛ kàfafwee ntabwey ande a ipfɛy a swaa ntɔn baar a Isàlɛl bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aman ntsüü a un'nyäŋ mpa afàlam.
Wɛɛ, un'yɛnà aba kàkäl aŋàbwà làpib, tii ŋàbawà, kya bàsàtaŋ Nkwà Itaan, làpib alà là kapaa. La ŋàtàlwomà anki, ntɔn la làsàyaalà amu Klistɔ.
Inye, tii ŋàbawà, taaŋ lanswà bàfàtaŋ ba Mɔsɛ, làpib là u mpem aba.
Wɛɛ mbuul a mpem akà Mwol mpɛl ifàlwom làpib.
Ntɔn Mwol wà Dweelà, ikal awà Dweelà a Mwol, ikal ayà nsaay.
Bi banswà, baar ibye anà ntabwey aŋàlwom làpib, bi iwàmumɛɛy làkoo a Mwol, bi ibà aŋàsɔɔmà unsà isii nsil aki, anà làkoo làŋàsöön kölàköl taaŋ lanswà u mbwo a Mwol, awà Dweelà.
